actions.name: ARCHIVE_DOWNLOAD

actions.name: EXPLICIT_DELIVERY
actions.webFiles: append first delivery timestamp only; all batch files required before becoming whole-country baseline

readPolicy: SELECT-only native ViewOrder and OrderHistory with exact country/year/full week. Native server offset +540 must be verified before interpreting GETDATE history. Hidden native orders block all export. No paid analysis or automatic retries.

criteriaLedger.identity: country + OrderYear + exact OrderWeek + CustKey + ProdKey + native unit; sourceKey and native history/detail IDs distinguish equal-quantity separate orders
criteriaLedger.default: all current ERP cells are preserved; chat inclusion is opt-in; analysis summary starts collapsed; first baseline with no chat is valid, unknown historical baseline cannot prove an addition
criteriaLedger.threeTimes: last complete delivered batch ERP snapshot, original chat timestamp, current native detail/history timestamp; current product factors never invent historical quantity
criteriaLedger.review: partial110 for chat20, missing timestamps, change/cancel, stale fingerprint, wrong year/country/unit, reused native event and native-total disagreement block export
criteriaLedger.pending: already delivered but unregistered chat is carried forward once until a unique explicit native event consumes it; it must not disappear on app reentry
criteriaLedger.generation: scope selection reads only; explicit preview generates with the same reconciliation helper as archive; native snapshot and delivery-baseline fingerprints are revalidated under scope owner lock
criteriaLedger.archive: private existing data/runtime file infrastructure; no DB schema; create-only xlsx and JSON via flush/link; separate first-delivery event; scope lock uses existing dead-owner-safe helper
criteriaLedger.authorization: active canManageInvoiceReceipt team, no service identity; same authority for shared list, read, preview, archive and delivery; raw file paths and credentials are never returned
criteriaLedger.legacy: existing ETA, country worksheets/formulas, farm partition and explicit file-only quantity review remain; direct quantity override plus chat inclusion requires separate review
criteriaLedger.desktop: same stable /import/tools menu URL, searchable label and favorite identity, 1.3.59 source version; isolated real main/shell session intercepts all network to loopback, production policy remains unchanged
